decidedValue.chapter: Track B authored pathway (no book chapter); anchored by ch10/opening on academic integrity in the age of generative AI. Foundations and basic application held out of scope for the introductory and intermediate tiers.

tierWindow.goal: Prompt AI skilfully to learn: build strong prompts, deepen a dialogue with deliberate moves, and use techniques that make you do the thinking, as one deliberate, critical and honest practice.
tierWindow.cognitiveDemand: Evaluation, creation, justification and ethical reasoning (evaluate, appraise, create, justify, critique).
tierWindow.taskComplexity: Open, ill-defined situations with competing considerations; contested judgements such as how far to trust an output, where authorship lies, and whether and how to disclose AI use.
tierWindow.autonomy: Low scaffolding; the learner exercises and defends their own judgement; feedback probes reasoning rather than confirming recall; stakes are realistic.

decidedValue.priorExperienceAnchor: The learner already understands what AI is (introductory) and has used it critically on study tasks (intermediate). This course does not re-teach the basics; it teaches skilled prompting - the framework, the moves and the techniques - and asks the learner to combine them into their own routine.

decidedValue.signpostBody: The course has four short lessons. First, the prompt framework: a role, a function and context. Second, prompt moves: deepening a dialogue instead of restarting. Third, techniques that build understanding. Fourth, designing your own routine that joins all three. Work through them in order; each builds on the one before.
decidedValue.signpostInstruction: Work through the three lessons in order.
decidedValue.overview: This course is about prompting AI to learn, at an advanced level. By the end you will be able to build strong prompts, deepen a dialogue with deliberate moves, and use techniques that make you do the thinking, all as one deliberate, critical and honest practice.
decidedValue.courseOutcomesFraming: Three course outcomes framed up front: build effective prompts, combine moves to deepen a dialogue, and design techniques that build your own understanding.

practiceConnection.academic: Prompting well is becoming part of academic and professional work. The skill you build here carries into every module, and into work where driving these tools well, and staying the one who thinks, is already expected.

grounding.note: W-OPEN states the three course outcomes and why they matter (AL-5)
